_provenance: Live probe, sandbox tenant, 2026-06-13. Method: temporary onCreate/onUpdate hooks installed on the scratch type managed/alpha_lock dumped typeof/getClass/JSON.stringify of each binding into the created record, then schema restored byte-identical and probe records deleted. See docs/api/10-managed-objects.md 'Hook scripts'. Header/token values sanitized.
engine: Rhino (IDM, same 1.7.14 family as endpoints/schedules — not independently re-verified for hooks)

bindings_all_hooks.openidm: object — the IDM functions surface (create/read/update/patch/query/delete/action). Rhino scriptable; getClass() not available on it.
bindings_all_hooks.require: function — CommonJS-style require, as in endpoint scripts.
bindings_all_hooks.context: object — serializable context chain, see context_chain.
bindings_all_hooks.request: object — the triggering CREST request, shape depends on method; see request_create.
bindings_all_hooks.resourceName: object — Java org.forgerock.json.resource.ResourcePath (the only binding where getClass() works). String(resourceName) is e.g. 'managed/alpha_lock/<id>'.

bindings_onCreate.object: object — the draft record; mutable (writes persist to the created record).

bindings_onUpdate.object: object — the incoming new state; mutable; object === newObject (verified).
bindings_onUpdate.oldObject: object — the previous record state (verified non-null with prior field values).

request_update._comment: verified via request.method === 'update' in onUpdate; full shape not dumped

context_chain: org.forgerock.json.resource.http.HttpContext (name=http — method, path, headers incl. Authorization; treat as sensitive)

runtime_gotchas.scope_enumeration_fatal: `for (var k in this)` at hook top level throws → the triggering HTTP request fails with 500 and the write is rolled back. Probe binding names with `typeof <name>` instead.
runtime_gotchas.eval: not separately isolated; the failing probe used both eval and for-in — for-in alone reproduced the 500, eval-free probes all worked. Avoid both.
runtime_gotchas.hook_error_surface: any uncaught hook exception → HTTP 500 {code:500} on the caller's request; the record is not created.
runtime_gotchas.getClass: works on Java-backed bindings (resourceName); Rhino-scriptable bindings (request/context/object/openidm/…) have no getClass.
